['DB Regio AG '].company_description: DB Regio AG operates in the railway transportation sector and offers modern S-Bahn trains, automated train services, and regional rail operations in Germany.

['HelloFresh SE '].company_description: HelloFresh SE operates in the USA and internationally, including operations in Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
